name: 11234 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11234 (Brooklyn) has 335 nonprofit organizations. 94 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11234 (Brooklyn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 64 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 64 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
